import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]);seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)];out=[]

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
T=G['Test input']
H,W=len(T),len(T[0])
# find template (color 1 copy) and palette (rows14-16, cols8-12)
cells1=[(y,x) for y in range(H) for x in range(W) if T[y][x]==1 and y<14]
t0=min(y for y,_ in cells1); c0=min(x for _,x in cells1)
tpl=[(y-t0,x-c0) for y,x in cells1]
res=[row[:] for row in T]
# erase palette and old 1-shape
for r in range(14,17):
    for c in range(8,13): res[r][c]=0
for y,x in cells1: res[y][x]=0
# palette column order -> slots 0..4, base = top of slot for color 1 (slot 2)
tops=[0,3,6,9,12]
for i,col in enumerate([2,3,1,8,7]):
    top=tops[i]
    for dy,dx in tpl:
        res[top+dy][c0+dx]=col
print(json.dumps(res))
